title: Understanding the Model
text: The model is a linear regression with coefficients for vegetables and types of meat. The equation is: f(x)=theta_0+theta_1*veg+theta_2*(meat=beef)+theta_3*(meat=fish).

title: Identify the Variables
text: For the first data point, $$veg=1$$ and $$meat=beef$$. This means the indicator variable for beef is $$1$$, and for fish, it is $$0$$.

title: Calculate the Prediction
text: Substitute the values into the model: f(x)=-3+5*veg+8*(meat=beef)+12*(meat=fish). What is the result?
